authorization_scope: First S0 falsification fixtures and S1 retained-inline visibility diagnostic, following user request to use the available Furnace. No training or promotion.
source_binding_rule: Freeze the implementation file hashes in the launch receipt after tests, before any GPU diagnostic; do not treat this design plan as runtime validation.
selection: First two paired-world records in file order, identical for both checkpoints; selection frozen before inspecting V13 outputs.
gain_rule: Descriptive visibility only; no gain selection, threshold fitting, learned intervention, or semantic promotion.
claim_boundary: A bounded numerical diagnostic on two retained V12 checkpoints and old evaluation data. It does not complete S0 task qualification, train V13, establish content-specific workspace use, or identify a V14 bridge. Synthetic fixture results are not model results.
